prompt:
Loop 058 — bounded MEDIUM tests/docs-only timeout static inventory.

Goal:
Create one machine-checkable inventory of the Relay timeout contract as it exists in the accepted static code today. This task must distinguish:
- static behavior that is already directly proven,
- optional/None timeout surfaces that still exist,
- exact finite values that are present only in test/control infrastructure,
- provider-specific real live timeout values that remain UNKNOWN/unselected.
Do NOT choose new production timeout values and do NOT perform any live/provider/network action.

Read first:
- docs/JULES_TASK_PROMPT_SPEC.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_ACQUISITION_PLAN.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_TO_LIVE_GAP_AUDIT.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_BLOCKERS.md
- docs/PHASE0_IMPLEMENTATION_CHECKLIST.md if present
- src/relay/envelope.py
- src/relay/dispatcher.py
- src/relay/lifecycle.py
- src/relay/transport.py
- src/relay/mock_transport.py
- src/relay/acp_client.py
- src/providers/policy.py
- src/providers/preflight.py
- src/providers/factory.py
- existing relay tests that already exercise timeout forwarding/cancel behavior

Allowed changed paths only:
- tests/relay/test_timeout_static_inventory.py
- docs/RELAY_TIMEOUT_STATIC_INVENTORY.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
- tests/docs/checkpoint only
- no src/ production implementation changes
- no schemas
- no workflows or workflow permissions
- no dependency/lockfile changes
- no provider/model/API/network/socket/HTTP action
- no auth/credential/billing/settings mutation
- no OIDC or attestation action
- no Merge
- no rebase / merge commit / force push / conflict auto-resolution
- retry=0
- fallback=disabled
- do not assign any new provider-specific timeout value
- do not claim a real live timeout is proven from mock/static behavior
- if an out-of-scope production change is required, STOP and report instead

Reuse-first:
- Reuse/import the accepted current timeout behavior from src/relay/envelope.py, lifecycle.py, dispatcher.py, transport.py, mock_transport.py and existing tests.
- Do not duplicate production validation logic inside the test.
- Use direct behavior/introspection where practical.
- Do not copy old timeout values from unrelated command-bus/workflow/controller timeouts and present them as Relay provider timeout values.

Required semantics:
1. Add docs/RELAY_TIMEOUT_STATIC_INVENTORY.md with a stable inventory table containing at minimum:
   - surface_id
   - canonical_source
   - current_static_contract
   - exact_value_or_default
   - evidence_kind
   - live_meaning
   - state
2. Represent these surfaces separately:
   - timeout_validator
   - dispatch_envelope
   - dispatcher_forwarding
   - lifecycle_forwarding
   - transport_protocol
   - mock_transport_observation
   - acp_client_mock
   - provider_policy_openai
   - provider_policy_anthropic
   - provider_policy_google
   - provider_preflight
   - provider_factory
3. The inventory must directly state current accepted facts:
   - validate_timeout accepts None;
   - positive non-bool integers are accepted;
   - bool, non-int, zero, and negative values are rejected;
   - DispatchEnvelope.timeout_seconds defaults to None;
   - RelayTransport.prompt timeout_seconds defaults to None;
   - lifecycle forwards envelope.timeout_seconds into exactly one prompt attempt;
   - TimeoutError after session open causes cancel before final close in static/mock lifecycle behavior;
   - MockTransport records the forwarded timeout;
   - ACPClient mock accepts timeout_seconds but does not prove a real provider process enforces it;
   - current ProviderPolicy has no provider-specific timeout field;
   - current validate_provider_static / factory path does not establish an exact provider timeout value;
   - therefore exact finite production/live timeout values for openai / anthropic / google remain UNKNOWN.
4. Inventory state vocabulary must be conservative:
   - STATIC_PROVEN
   - STATIC_OBSERVED
   - UNKNOWN_LIVE
   Do not use READY/PASS/VERIFIED/LIVE_AUTHORIZED/RESOLVED for real live timeout readiness.
5. Exact numeric values from unrelated layers (GitHub Actions timeout-minutes, command-bus HTTP timeouts, probe timeouts, test harness waits) must be excluded from provider live timeout conclusions.
6. If an exact numeric timeout is observed only in a mock/test/control surface, label its evidence_kind and live_meaning so it cannot be mistaken for provider production timeout policy.
7. The document must explicitly state:
   - this inventory performs zero live execution;
   - it does not choose timeout values;
   - it does not resolve common_timeout;
   - provider-specific exact finite live timeout values remain UNKNOWN;
   - first live provider turn remains separately human-approved.
8. Update RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md with PREPARED/static timeout-inventory status only.

Negative / tamper / failure cases:
- tests must directly call validate_timeout and prove:
  - None accepted
  - representative positive int accepted
  - True/False rejected
  - 0 and negative rejected
  - float/string/list/mapping rejected
- tests must introspect DispatchEnvelope.build/field default and RelayTransport.prompt signature so default None cannot silently change without test failure
- tests must prove lifecycle forwards an explicit timeout to MockTransport and makes one prompt attempt
- tests must prove timeout path cancels exactly once and closes exactly once with one prompt attempt
- tests must verify provider policies/preflight/factory do not expose or establish provider-specific timeout values
- tests must parse the inventory table and assert exact required surface_id set
- tests must assert openai/anthropic/google live timeout rows remain UNKNOWN_LIVE
- tests must assert no unrelated workflow/command-bus/probe timeout numeric value is presented as a provider live timeout
- tests must read checkpoint and assert PREPARED/static/no-live/no-resolution wording
- no vacuous tests: no pass, assertTrue(True), or unrelated string placeholders

Acceptance criteria:
- changed paths exactly within the allowlist
- current production code is not modified
- every claimed static fact has direct behavior/introspection/source evidence
- exact provider live timeout values remain UNKNOWN
- no new timeout value is selected
- no real live blocker is claimed resolved
- pre-existing green tests alone are not acceptance

Exact validation commands:
Run focused test(s) first as useful, then exactly once:
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q src tests
git diff --check

Publication condition:
Publish the normal isolated Jules PR only if the exact path fence holds, full validation is green, and all semantic assertions above are directly covered. Do not Merge.

Explicit stop conditions:
- stop if a claimed timeout value can only be sourced from unrelated controller/workflow/test infrastructure
- stop if selecting a real provider timeout requires an architecture/product decision
- stop if a production source/schema/workflow change is required
- stop if any live/provider/auth/billing/permission action would be required
- stop instead of guessing when exact live timeout evidence is unavailable
